readerCopy.body: Recognition can bring back the exact memory that once taught visibility to feel dangerous. When the Sun conjoins Chiron, identity and sensitivity fuse, allowing praise, attention, leadership, or being seen for a piece of work to feel more exposing than the present situation alone explains. You may notice that welcome attention still makes you want to protect yourself from an older kind of judgment. The people present now do not automatically carry the same consequence as the people who originally made visibility costly.
